name: seated hip external rotation
description: A seated rotation turning the thigh outward. It improves hip mobility and activates the deep rotators.
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your knee still and rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns outward.
Pause when you feel the hip working.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
